content_sections.heading: Shipping Corporation of India Assistant Medical Officer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Indian Nationals only need to apply.

rows.qualification_required: MBBS Degree from any recognised Indian University/ Institute recognised by Medical Council of India (MCI) with minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience. Certificates for the same should be provided. In the event of self-practice, the candidate has to provide sufficient documentary evidence in support of their experience. The applicant should also have a valid Directorate General of Maritime Administration (DGMA) approval at the time of application. In case of selection, the DGMA approval of the selected candidate should be valid throughout the tenure of the contract.

content_sections.heading: Shipping Corporation of India Assistant Medical Officer Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on shortlisting and a personal interview. Candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of eligibility criteria for Educational Qualification, Experience, and valid DGMA Approval. In case of receipt of a large number of applications, the Company reserves the right to shortlist candidates for interview out of eligible candidates in the ratio of 1:10, based on higher experience post qualification. In case of a tie in interview marks, candidates with more years of experience will be placed higher in merit. Selection will be based on a Personal Interview conducted physically at SCI Head Office, Mumbai for AMO – SCI Head Office and AMO – SCI MTI; at SCI Chennai Office for AMO – SCI Chennai; and at SCI Kolkata Office for AMO – SCI Kolkata. The Selection Committee from Mumbai HO will join virtually (video conferencing) as per requirement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Shipping Corporation of India Assistant Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Visit the Corporation's website at www.shipindia.com and navigate to Career -> Shore -> Recruitment of Assistant Medical Officers on Contract (Advt No. HR 06/2026). Fill out the online application form. Club, join, or scan the required documents into a single PDF file (maximum size 10 MB) and upload it under the upload required document section. Send your updated resume along with the document file via email to [email protected] with the subject "Application for Assistant Medical Officer on Contract – (Advt. No. HR 06/2026)". Ensure the application and documents are submitted on or before 29/10/2026 (2359 hours).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Mark sheets and Degree certificate of qualifying exam i.e. MBBS Valid DGMA approval Date of Birth proof like Aadhar card, Pan card, Voter ID Card, or Birth Certificate Address Proof Documents validating required qualification and experience Updated Resume

faq.question: Q1. What is the Shipping Corporation of India Assistant Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive released under advertisement number HR 06/2026 to hire 4 Assistant Medical Officers on a contract basis for SCI offices in Mumbai, Chennai, and Kolkata.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies, out of which 3 are Unreserved (UR) and 1 is reserved for Other Backward Classes - Non-Creamy Layer (OBC-NCL).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 29/10/2026 up to 2359 hours.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree from a recognised Indian University or Institute recognised by the Medical Council of India (MCI) with a minimum of 5 years of post-qualification experience and a valid Directorate General of Maritime Administration (DGMA) approval.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 62 years as on 01.09.2026, meaning the date of birth should be on or after 01.09.1964.
